name: Sharpness
whatItDoes: Increases melee damage. In Java Edition each level adds 0.5 x level + 0.5 extra damage (Sharpness V = +3); in Bedrock it adds 1.25 damage per level (Sharpness V = +6.25).
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot chests, fishing, librarian villagers and bartering
bestUses: The default damage enchantment for your main sword or axe, since it works against every mob.
keywords: sharpness enchantment sword axe damage max level

name: Protection
whatItDoes: Reduces most damage types by 4% per level per piece (up to 80% total). Covers melee, projectiles, fire, explosions and falls - everything except hunger, void and /kill damage.
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarians
bestUses: Put Protection IV on all four armor pieces for general survival. Specialized protections (Fire, Blast, Projectile) only win against a single damage type.
keywords: protection enchantment armor damage reduction

name: Unbreaking
appliesTo: Tools, weapons, armor, fishing rods, bows, crossbows, tridents, shields, elytra, and more
whatItDoes: Gives each use a chance to not consume durability. For tools, III roughly quadruples lifetime; armor benefits less (about 43% longer at III).
bestUses: On every valuable item, ideally together with Mending: Unbreaking stretches durability, Mending refills it.
keywords: unbreaking enchantment durability tools armor

name: Mending
whatItDoes: XP orbs you collect repair the equipped item (2 durability per XP point) instead of filling your XP bar. Items in hand, off-hand and worn armor can be repaired.
howToGet: Treasure enchantment - NOT available from the enchanting table
Librarian villagers (any biome) selling enchanted books
Loot chests, fishing, raids (Bedrock), pillager outposts
bestUses: Your most valuable gear: netherite tools and armor, elytra, trident, bow. Combine with Unbreaking III.
keywords: mending enchantment how to get repair xp treasure

name: Efficiency
appliesTo: Pickaxes, shovels, axes, hoes and shears
whatItDoes: Increases mining speed: each level adds the square of the level plus 1 to breaking speed. Efficiency V makes stone-type blocks break almost instantly with a good pickaxe.
bestUses: Pickaxe first - mining speed defines your progress. Pair with Haste beacons for instant mining.
keywords: efficiency enchantment mining speed pickaxe

name: Fortune
whatItDoes: Multiplies drops from most ores and harvests. Fortune III averages 2.2x diamonds, up to 4x at best roll. Also increases flint, glowstone, melons and crop yields.
bestUses: A dedicated ore-mining pickaxe. Keep a separate Silk Touch pick for blocks you want unbroken.
keywords: fortune enchantment diamonds more drops

name: Silk Touch
whatItDoes: Blocks drop themselves instead of their usual items: stone instead of cobblestone, ore blocks instead of raw ore, glass, grass blocks, bee nests with bees inside, and more.
bestUses: Collecting glass, grass blocks, ore blocks for storage or decoration, moving bee nests, and mining ender chests without losing them.
keywords: silk touch enchantment blocks drop themselves

name: Looting
whatItDoes: Increases mob drops: +1 max common drop per level, and raises the chance of rare drops (wither skeleton skulls go from 2.5% to 5.5% at Looting III).
bestUses: Farming wither skeleton skulls, ender pearls, gunpowder and any mob resource. In Java, holding the sword when the mob dies is enough.
keywords: looting enchantment more drops wither skull sword

name: Feather Falling
whatItDoes: Reduces fall damage by 12% per level (48% at IV) and stacks with Protection up to the 80% cap. Also reduces ender pearl damage.
bestUses: Essential for building at height, exploring the End cities, and surviving elytra mistakes.
keywords: feather falling enchantment boots fall damage

name: Infinity
whatItDoes: You can shoot unlimited arrows as long as you carry at least one normal arrow. Tipped and spectral arrows are still consumed.
bestUses: General combat and skeleton farms where arrows are scarce. If you use tipped arrows, pick Mending instead.
keywords: infinity enchantment bow unlimited arrows

name: Fire Aspect
whatItDoes: Sets the target on fire on hit: 4 seconds per level (Fire Aspect II = 8 seconds). Burning animals drop cooked meat, and in Bedrock it also lights unlit candles, campfires and TNT when you hit them.
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot chests, fishing, librarian villagers and bartering
bestUses: Great on a mob-farm sword for auto-cooked meat. Skip it against endermen - fire makes them teleport constantly - and remember most Nether mobs are immune to fire.
keywords: fire aspect enchantment sword burn cooked meat

name: Knockback
whatItDoes: Adds about 3 blocks of knockback per level to your melee hits (Knockback II = roughly 6 extra blocks).
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Useful for keeping creepers at distance. Many players skip it on their main sword because it knocks mobs out of combo range and makes chaining hits harder.
keywords: knockback enchantment sword push back

name: Power
whatItDoes: Increases arrow damage by 25% x (level + 1): Power V deals 150% extra damage, up to 23 damage (11.5 hearts) on a fully drawn critical shot in Java.
howToGet: Enchanting table (levels I-IV common, V rare)
Enchanted books from loot chests, fishing, librarian villagers and bartering
Combine two Power IV bows or books in an anvil for Power V
bestUses: The number one bow enchantment. Power V one-shots most common hostile mobs with a full draw.
keywords: power enchantment bow damage max level

name: Punch
whatItDoes: Adds about 3 blocks of knockback per level to arrows (Punch II = roughly 6 extra blocks).
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Keeps melee mobs off you and knocks enemies off ledges; fun in PvP. Most players avoid it on endermen duty since they teleport anyway.
keywords: punch enchantment bow knockback

name: Thorns
whatItDoes: Each armor piece has a level x 15% chance to reflect 1-4 damage back to an attacker that hits you. Multiple pieces raise the chance that at least one procs, but only one piece deals damage per hit in Java.
howToGet: Enchanting table (levels I-III, rarer than most)
Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Situational: it punishes melee attackers but drains armor durability fast. Many players keep it off their main set and put it on a spare set instead.
keywords: thorns enchantment armor reflect damage durability

name: Respiration
whatItDoes: Extends underwater breathing time by 15 seconds per level (base 15s, so Respiration III = 60 seconds) and reduces how often drowning damage ticks.
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Essential for ocean monument raids, ruin looting and long underwater builds. Combine with Aqua Affinity and Depth Strider for the full diving set.
keywords: respiration enchantment helmet breathe underwater

name: Aqua Affinity
whatItDoes: Removes the underwater mining speed penalty - normally breaking blocks underwater takes 5x longer. With Aqua Affinity you mine at normal speed while submerged.
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Pair it with Respiration III for ocean monuments and underwater building. Note it does not remove the separate 5x penalty for mining while floating (not touching the floor).
keywords: aqua affinity enchantment underwater mining speed

name: Depth Strider
whatItDoes: Reduces how much water slows your movement: each level removes one third of the penalty, so Depth Strider III lets you swim at full walking speed. Also reduces how fast flowing water pushes you.
howToGet: Enchanted books from loot, fishing and librarian villagers
bestUses: Core piece of the diving set with Respiration III and Aqua Affinity for ocean monuments and underwater builds.
keywords: depth strider enchantment boots swim faster underwater

name: Soul Speed
whatItDoes: Increases movement speed on soul sand and soul soil - Soul Speed III makes you slightly faster on those blocks than normal walking on land. Each step on a soul block has a 4% chance to drain 1 boot durability.
howToGet: Barter with piglins (gold ingots) - they can offer enchanted books or iron boots with Soul Speed
Not available from the enchanting table: it is a treasure enchantment
bestUses: Soul sand valleys and nether highways. Bring spare boots or Mending - the durability drain adds up on long runs.
keywords: soul speed enchantment boots soul sand bartering treasure

name: Swift Sneak
whatItDoes: Increases sneaking speed: each level adds 15% of walking speed, so Swift Sneak III lets you sneak at 75% of normal walking speed.
howToGet: Loot chests in ancient cities in the deep dark - the only source in the game
Not available from the enchanting table, trading or fishing: it is a treasure enchantment exclusive to ancient cities
bestUses: Ancient city looting runs - sneak past sculk sensors and the Warden much faster. Apply it to leggings in an anvil.
keywords: swift sneak enchantment leggings ancient city warden sneaking faster
